contract.role: kF0 (lambdaPN=1 and kFrame=0: geoPN=1, and the compat input geoPN=2 with kFrame=0)
contract.sources: EIH core: all finite-mass bodies are sources; active test particles only receive; the optical-angle/radius cutoff is for ray drawing only
contract.sourceExclusion: pnSource:false excludes a body lighter than the ray-drawing cutoff (a heavier body stays a source through the unchanged _core threshold)
contract.pinned: pinned receivers receive nothing; a pinned source has g_b=0
contract.conserved: 1PN energy and momentum (sum of dL/dv), not the Newtonian sum of m*v
contract.split: _core adds the test-particle form (core=1, no reaction); dfmPN1EIHKick adds Delta = EIH - test-particle form before _core
